description: PAID $0.001 USDC on Base mainnet via x402 (the first 100 calls per client per UTC day are free over HTTP GET /v1/check). Measured facts for one host (an x402 seller, or a remote MCP server host: handshake state, protocol version, tools count/hash and change history, auth needed, latency): valid-402 rate, latency p50/p90, price and payTo vs listing, paid test-buys with Base tx links, freshness, last 5 receipts. An unpaid call returns an x402 v2 PaymentRequired tool error (isError, structuredContent with accepts); an x402-aware MCP client signs it and retries with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. Input is checked before any payment request; charged only when the tool returns an answer (settlement in result _meta["x402/payment-response"]).
